item.title: Criminal Surcharge Funding Helps Victims When They Need it Most
item.description: More than £1 million from Scotland’s Victim Surcharge Fund is being shared among 19 organisations, including Medics Against Violence, helping victims of crime receive immediate, practical support funded directly by penalties imposed on offenders.The post Criminal Surcharge Funding Helps Victims When They Need it Most appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: North of Scotland Left Out as Westminster Funding Branded Pitiful
item.description: SNP representatives in Moray have criticised the UK Government after the North of Scotland was excluded from a £140 million funding round, describing the investment as pitiful and warning that communities continue to be treated as an afterthought. The post North of Scotland Left Out as Westminster Funding Branded Pitiful appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Highland and Lowland League Clubs Invited to Apply for Cup Places
item.description: Highland League and Lowland League clubs have been invited to apply for places in next season’s Premier Sports Cup and KDM Evolution Trophy, with prize money on offer and a chance to compete on the national stage.The post Highland and Lowland League Clubs Invited to Apply for Cup Places appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: New Year Funding Boost for Highland Sports Clubs Through Get Active Scotland
item.description: Thirty one Highland sports clubs are sharing new funding through Get Active Scotland, supporting projects that help children, young people and rural communities become more active and improve health and wellbeing across the region.The post New Year Funding Boost for Highland Sports Clubs Through Get Active Scotland appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Eden Court Marks 50 Years With a Year of Celebration Across The Highlands
item.description: Eden Court is marking its 50th anniversary with a year long programme of concerts, performances, exhibitions and community events, celebrating five decades at the heart of Highland cultural life and inviting audiences to help shape the next chapter.The post Eden Court Marks 50 Years With a Year of Celebration Across The Highlands appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Wildlife Groups Seek Support to Protect Loch Ness and Ancient Woodland
item.description: Wildlife groups are seeking public support to challenge plans for a pumped storage hydro scheme near Loch Ness, warning of damage to ancient woodland, freshwater ecosystems and species already under severe pressure.The post Wildlife Groups Seek Support to Protect Loch Ness and Ancient Woodland appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Highland Woman Speaks Out as Iran is Silenced and Protesters are Killed
item.description: An Iranian woman living in the Scottish Highlands has spoken out about mass protests, internet blackouts and reports of thousands killed in Iran, warning that families are being cut off, voices silenced, and history is repeating itself.The post Highland Woman Speaks Out as Iran is Silenced and Protesters are Killed appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: SNP Says it is Leading The Fight to Protect Scotland’s Whisky Industry
item.description: The SNP has moved to block a proposed whisky tax rise at Westminster, with Moray MP Graham Leadbitter warning that Scotland’s world class whisky industry and thousands of local jobs are being put at risk.The post SNP Says it is Leading The Fight to Protect Scotland’s Whisky Industry appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Suzuki’s Industry Leading Warranty Now Available in The Highlands
item.description: Suzuki’s industry leading 10 year motorcycle warranty is now available in the Highlands, with Dicksons of Inverness confirmed as the new official Suzuki bike dealer for the region.The post Suzuki’s Industry Leading Warranty Now Available in The Highlands appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Highland Taxpayers Turn to HMRC App as Self Assessment Deadline Looms
item.description: More Highland taxpayers are using the HMRC app to pay their Self Assessment bills, as the 31 January deadline approaches and penalties loom for anyone who files or pays late.The post Highland Taxpayers Turn to HMRC App as Self Assessment Deadline Looms appeared first on The Highland Times.
